variants.observation: 阈值 0.5，保留 11 个候选框。同一输入运行三次，框坐标、类别和分数一致。 按 COCO 官方标注核对，同类别 IoU≥0.5 时，9 个框匹配、2 个候选未匹配、11 个标注目标未匹配。未匹配候选可能来自定位差异、重复或标注范围，不直接等同于画面不存在该物体。

hostPostprocessing.purpose: Official bbox head only; backbone and class logits run on the card.

annotationReview.matching: COCOeval bbox category-aware descending-score greedy one-to-one matching at IoU 0.5 and 0.75, no crowd/ignore in these images, maxDets100, all sizes, original unclipped boxes. Matched IoUs independently recomputed.
annotationReview.scope: Only this archived sample; no new inference; not full COCO mAP.
